title: Shop supplies on a billable work order follow the percentage as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location charges shop supplies at 10% of labor.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour and no shop supplies rule.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Shop supplies reads $24.00 (10% of $240.00).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S10-R2: “The amount can be changed on the work order until it is closed, with the existing per-work-order shop supplies control. Any customer change while the work order stays internal or no charge, or converting to no charge, resets it to the customer's Min. Making the work order billable again drops the flat amount and applies the customer's or the location's shop supplies rule as on any billable work order.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Regular work orders, invoicing, payments, discounts, credits and the customer portal behave exactly as they do today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
